notes.title: Three major updates
notes.content:
Challenge difficulty:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443966/711175d3d06d80c7da9aef6e5e4dadc1ce2b26be.jpg[/img]
You can choose various options to increase the difficulty of the challenge, obtain red magic weapons, and start the challenge on 30 difficulty,
Drop red treasures with full attributes on difficulty 50, and drop 10 inlaid red treasures on difficulty 100 and above

Red magic weapon launched:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443966/035b51b5e9e1a7bf45903682c7c81a24a9d59843.jpg[/img]
You can synthesize magic treasures in the Bagua Furnace and refine them.
Each practice requires 1000 merits. It is recommended to use red magic weapons with 50 attributes to practice.

Purchase and launch of magic treasures within the replica:
[img{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443966/c90716a32e260371305d827674354951abb6c10a.jpg[/img]
If the store in the dungeon is above level 2, you can purchase temporary treasures and spend coins to refresh the types of treasures.
At the beginning of the dungeon, auxiliary magic weapons are continuously dropped. If the damage is not enough, suitable ones can be purchased and used in the store.

notes.title: Updated new DEMO
notes.content: Most of the systems have been optimized, and those who are interested can experience it. Thank you
